steps.headline: Every theme card is now the same height, so the active card no longer grows and stretches its neighbour.
steps.changed: Picture on top, one text row at the bottom, and every card the same height. Built-ins got preview pictures from the marketplace generator; other themes show their own preview.
steps.measured: The active card 59 px vs 34 px for every other card, before
steps.notice: The grid stops jumping when you pick a theme, and any theme that has a preview picture now shows it instead of a colour strip.
steps.risk: In these screenshots Halftone and Meadow still show the colour strip because the screenshot tool cannot load theme folders; in the app they show their own preview.

steps.headline: “Your Themes” reads “Favorited Themes”, “Browse all themes →” is gone, and Browse Theme Marketplace sits above Build New Theme.
steps.changed: Renamed the heading, removed the text-link row, reordered the two buttons.
steps.notice: One less button under the theme grid, and the Marketplace button now comes first. The separate list of your installed themes that the old link opened is no longer reachable from here.

steps.headline: The featured card uses the theme’s normal card edge; the gold border is gone.
steps.changed: One border style for every card. The small FEATURED label above the name is now the only thing marking it.
steps.measured: 3 different featured borders before, none now
steps.notice: The Marketplace opens calmer — no single card shouts — and the featured one still reads first because it sits first.

steps.headline: A plugin with a single install now reads “1 install”, not “1 installs”.
steps.changed: One shared counting rule for both numbers on the card, pinned by a test.
steps.notice: Install and like counts read correctly everywhere a card shows them; nothing else on the card moves.
steps.risk: The likes count runs off the edge of these cards, so only the install count is visible in the picture.

steps.headline: A brand-new Library shows “Nothing installed yet” and a Browse the Marketplace button, instead of two headings over blank space.
steps.changed: Fixed the counting mistake that made every section believe it already had contents, then used the app’s standard empty message. A test pins it.
steps.notice: A new user lands on a Library that tells them what to do next. If you already have things installed, they still show exactly as before — only the switcher above them changes (next step).

steps.headline: The Skills and Themes switcher now matches Projects: an icon, a label, and how many you have installed.
steps.changed: Swapped the two plain text pills for the same bordered tabs Projects already uses. Projects itself is untouched.
steps.notice: You can see how many skills and themes you have without opening either tab, and the switcher is bigger and easier to hit.
steps.risk: The tabs stand taller than the old plain pills, so everything below them sits a little lower.

steps.headline: Plugins / Themes is now a pick-one switch with an All option, in the same spot; the filters after it stay pills.
steps.changed: The pick-one choice is drawn as a switch; the pick-any filters keep their pill shape. The phone filter sheet got the same switch.
steps.notice: It reads at a glance that you pick one of Plugins or Themes, but any number of the filters — they no longer look like the same kind of button.

steps.headline: The search box is the app’s shared search field with a magnifier, the same height as the pills beside it.
steps.changed: Replaced the bare box with the shared search field Projects already uses. On phones that same field carries the Filters button.
steps.notice: Search looks the same here as everywhere else in the app, and no longer sits shorter than its neighbours.

steps.headline: When nothing matches your filters you get one message with a Clear filters button, instead of two messages and no way back.
steps.changed: Replaced the “0 results” line and the second sentence with the app’s standard empty message.
steps.notice: One sentence to read, and a button that puts the full list back in a single click.

steps.headline: At phone width the title reads “Marketplace” again instead of being cut to “Ma…”.
steps.changed: The “Esc · Back to chat” hint is no longer drawn at phone width. It was meant to hide there and never did, so it took the title’s room.
steps.measured: 390 px wide; the title was cut to 2 letters
steps.notice: The screen name is readable on a phone. The Esc hint is gone at that width and unchanged on a desktop-sized window.
steps.risk: The reason the hint refused to hide is a bug in the app’s shared button; it is filed for a proper fix and could affect other screens.
